summary: Iter 61 ($0 stabilization) — tested 3 changes end-to-end: (1) MemoryPackageSelect.jsx rendering inside ClarityRelease confirmation panel, (2) Body Room TTS button inside BodyRoomChat, (3) regression on 5 prior backend test suites. Result: MemoryPackageSelect works as specced; Body Room TTS is BROKEN at runtime (ReferenceError); all 5 regression suites still green; no new backend endpoints added (verified via network monitor — only POST /api/clarity/prefs and POST /api/clarity/tts are exercised by the new UI).

ui_bugs.issue: RUNTIME ReferenceError: 'TTS_TOKEN_KEY is not defined'. The review brief states TTS_TOKEN_KEY/TTS_BACKEND_URL constants and Volume2/VolumeX/Headphones imports were added — they were NOT. Only Volume2 is imported (line 15). VolumeX and Headphones are referenced on line 367, TTS_TOKEN_KEY/TTS_BACKEND_URL on lines 320/322/328. ESLint did not catch this (no no-undef rule). Initial render survives because the ternary on line 367 evaluates to Volume2 in the 'idle' state — but the moment the user clicks the Listen button, handleClick() throws and the whole React tree hits an Uncaught runtime error overlay. Verified live with synthetic Bearer session: button label stays 'Listen', red error overlay appears, page error: 'TTS_TOKEN_KEY is not defined at handleClick'.

integration_issues.issue: Unreachable. /api/clarity/tts is never called from Body Room because handleClick() throws before fetch. (The endpoint itself works — verified by Course Room test_course_tts_iter58.py which returned 136320 bytes audio/mpeg with ETag.)

action_items: FIX BodyRoomChat.jsx: add the 3 missing pieces at file top — `import { Send, RotateCcw, Volume2, VolumeX, Headphones } from 'lucide-react';` and two module constants `const TTS_TOKEN_KEY = 'aurin_session_token';` and `const TTS_BACKEND_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || '';` (mirror the pattern used in CourseRoom TTS). Without this fix, every wanderer who clicks Listen in Body Room sees a red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay.

After fix, verify: (a) Listen button cycles label Listen → Loading… → Pause → Resume; (b) audio actually plays (mp3 blob); (c) clicking the button on a second guide reply re-uses /api/clarity/tts (no 404).
critical_code_review_comments: BodyRoomChat.jsx ESLint passed despite 4 undefined identifiers — the project's eslint config does not enforce no-undef on jsx; consider enabling it so this class of regression cannot ship again.
MemoryPackageSelect uses inline color tokens (#5BA7C4 / #E0B45A) — fine for a $0 stab change, but a follow-up should fold them into the aurin design system if Eternal Thread becomes permanent.

MemoryPackageSelect onChange does `updateClarityPrefs(...).catch(()=>{})` — silently swallowing failures means a save_threads write that fails (network, 401) leaves the UI showing the new selection while the server still has the old value. Consider rolling back state on rejection.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE — Iter 61 commit added SomaticTtsButton that references TTS_TOKEN_KEY, TTS_BACKEND_URL, VolumeX and Headphones, but the corresponding imports/constants at the top of BodyRoomChat.jsx were forgotten. The review brief explicitly says these were added; grep confirms they were not. ReferenceError fires only inside handleClick (lines 318-328) and inside the Icon ternary (line 367) when state moves to 'playing'/'loading' — so initial render is clean and ESLint did not catch it. MITIGATION: add to BodyRoomChat.jsx: `import { Send, RotateCcw, Volume2, VolumeX, Headphones } from 'lucide-react';` (line 15), and after STORE_KEY: `const TTS_TOKEN_KEY = 'aurin_session_token'; const TTS_BACKEND_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || '';`. No backend change needed.
